chunks: What al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz and Ribʿī, who raised it to Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

When it is the night of Friday, it is recommended that in the ʿatamah prayer, Sūrat al-Jumuʿah and Sūrat Idhā Jāʾaka al-Munāfiqūn be recited; and in the morning prayer likewise; and in the Friday prayer likewise; and in the ʿaṣr prayer likewise.

key_terms.إِذَا جَاءَكَ ٱلْمُنَافِقُونَ: Sūrat al-Munāfiqūn, named by its opening words
key_terms.سُورَةُ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ: the surah al-Jumuʿah to be recited in prayer

ai.seo_question: What surahs are recommended to recite in the prayers of Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the recommended recitation for certain prayers connected with Friday. It instructs that Sūrat al-Jumuʿah and Sūrat al-Munāfiqūn be recited in the night prayer of Friday, the morning prayer, the Friday prayer, and the ʿaṣr prayer.
